proved Actual positive loop, two-disc gluing isomorphism and spin filling Read the complete proof and rederived the positive loop c(r)=c0-2r, its closing map F_(2,c0-2), and the connection-independence isotopy. The glued oriented seven-manifold is a homotopy sphere by van Kampen and integral Mayer–Vietoris. Opened Milnor1965 Theorem9.1p107 and PropositionsA–Bpp108–110 with their full displayed proofs, then inserted the exact two-ball complement, relative homology vanishing and product boundary parametrization. The parametrized-ball isotopy gives injectivity up to a disc extension; the opened Cerf1970Theorem0/Corollaries1–2p8 turn that extension into isotopy. Smale1961TheoremJp393 identifies oriented h-cobordism and diffeomorphism classes. Opened Eells–Kuiper1962§3p96 and§6pp101–103; the explicit h=2 rank-four disc bundle has Euler1,p1=6x,signature1 and mu1/28. Boundary sums and orientation reversal supply a spin filling of every class, including the actual Sigma_Phi. Vanishing rational H3/H4 on the boundary makes the relative Pontryagin lift unique. The exact formula divided by896 and multiplied by28 gives the displayed residue modulo28.
